lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots is visible along the mid-to-posterior flank, following a rectilinear arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal trajectories to form a grid-like pattern, where large circular blobs are positioned at the nodal intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal carinae run across the upper and middle sections of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side of the ridge and deep shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 12-15 high-luminance spots of varying diameters, showing a moderately high density with slightly greater clustering near the posterior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch or irregular indentation is visible on the distal portion of the trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A clear phenotypic transition is observed from high-density, minute spots on the cephalic/rostrum region to the structured grid of larger macro-spots on the trunk.
